features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

features.name: Size
features.description: Alseid stand over 6 feet tall and weigh around 300 pounds. Your size is Medium.

features.name: Speed
features.description: Alseid are fast for their size, with a base walking speed of 40 feet.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: Accustomed to the limited light beneath the forest canopy, you have superior vision in dark and dim conditions. You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

features.name: Alseid Weapon Training
features.description: You have proficiency with spears and shortbows.

features.name: Light Hooves
features.description: You have proficiency in the Stealth skill.

features.name: Quadruped
features.description: The mundane details of the structures of humanoids can present considerable obstacles for you. You have to squeeze when moving through trapdoors, manholes, and similar structures. In addition, ladders, stairs, and similar structures are difficult terrain for you.

features.name: Woodfriend
features.description: When in a forest, you leave no tracks and can automatically discern true north.

features.name: Languages
features.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Elvish.
